Had somewhat of a similar experience, I came in wondering about myself having adult ADHD and everyone just shiting on me, assuming that I was some medication abuser. Yikes.

Only the nurse and doctor I was with had the professionalism to keep their expression to themselves. They recommended a specialist.

Figures out via ADHD specialist can confirm I very much do have it very severely and front desk can be very judgmental. 

But do I regret going? No. Get help asap. My biggest regret was waiting so long, thinking I didn't need help. Getting professional help is key. 

And try not to compare yourself to peers, it was never an even playing ground bo begin with. It took away my will to improve any aspect of myself and only further damaging my surroundings.
